thread:
zoe_design: quick sync YI: proposing a small nav tweak old 'Model routes' under a single 'Models & Catalog' cluster and move 'Deployments' higher. Want to keep deep links intact. thoughts? :thinking:
mike_pm: +1 on the ordering. main ask: deep links from saved bookmarks and SSO must land correctly. we need canonical URLs in the share dialog.
tara_frontend: doable. plan: canonicalize paths (e.g., /workspaces/:id/deployments) and keep alias rewrites for old slugs. client will history.replaceState to the canonical path on first load to avoid double loads.
olivia_router: prefer server-side rewrites at the edge to reduce client hops. will add an X-Original-Path header for 21 days so analytics can map hits. also propose reserved prefixes to avoid slug collisions.
jamal_a11y: accessibility: cluster headers must be semantic headings and keyboard-focusable. when a user lands via alias, announce the new context with aria-live polite: "Viewing Deployments in Workspace X". icon-only compact nav needs aria-labels and visible focus.
nana_research: did 6 quick tests inding: users find 'Deployments' faster when it's top-level and labeled as a noun. compact mode hurt new users; recommend an onboarding hint for icon-only mode.
opsbot: created ticket RDW-9001: nav aliases + migration banner. subtask RDW-9001a: UX copy A/B and RDW-9001b: alias manifest RFC.
zoe_design: decisions: 1) Models grouped as 'Models & Catalog' 2) Deployments moved up 3) canonical paths + alias rewrites 4) a11y checklist and onboarding hint. tara to mock cluster header + breadcrumb flow; olivia to draft alias manifest. reconvene after mocks. :white_check_mark:
